en.title: Maximum Subjects Passed with Limited Answers
en.description:
In subject i you have already answered answered[i] questions correctly, and you pass once you reach needed[i]. You can answer q more questions correctly in total; find the maximum number of subjects you can pass. Subjects already passed need no extra answers.

The standard input/output format was compiled by this site; added numeric bounds and the encoding for no-solution cases are explicitly marked and do not claim to be the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n q, the second line contains answered, and the third line contains needed. 1≤n≤100000, 0≤elements of both arrays≤10^9. The source has no bound on q; on this site 0≤q≤10^14.
hints: Compute the non-negative shortfall of each subject, sort them in ascending order, and spend the budget on the smallest shortfalls first.
